QuestInfo.name: Notice from the Excavation Team
QuestInfo.0: There's a new announcement posted on the #bRelic Excavation Association Board at the camp in Perion#k...
QuestInfo.1: You read the announcement on the board in #m101030104#. It said that many excavators have been injured by monsters so anyone up for a challenge should eliminate them and report to #bShawn#k.
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated the monsters of the Excavation Site, collected evidence, and spoke to Shawn the Excavation Leader.

0.0: - Announcement - \n\nA bloodthirsty band of skeletons has appeared in the Excavation Site and they are stirring up a ruckus! Any brave adventurer who helps eliminate these undead beasts will be rewarded. Capture #r50 Skeleton Soldiers, 30 Skeleton Officers, and 10 Skeleton Commanders#k, then report to Lead Excavator #bShawn#k.
0.1: * Small Reward Distribution\n\n* Bring #b30 Ribs, 20 Pelvic Bones, and 10 Horse Skulls#k to Shawn as proof.

0.0: - NOTICE - \n\nSpooky, scary skeletons have appeared in the Excavation Sites! Any brave adventurer who helps eliminate these horrors will be rewarded. If you participate, please collect evidence of your work and report to #r#p9040002##k.
0.1:
*#rRewards#k offered!

*When reporting to #p9040002#, please provide the items below as evidence.

   #i4000206# #b 7 Ribs

1.0: You must have seen the notice board. Show me the evidence. Hmm... This seems legit. I'll keep these bones for future research. Thank you for helping the Excavation Team out. Here's the reward like I promised.

yes.0: We appreciate your effort. Thank you for helping us out.

npc.0: Defeat #r20 Wooden Masks, 20 Rocky Masks, 20 Skeleton Soldiers, 20 Skeleton Officers, and 10 Skeleton Commanders#k, then bring #b7 Wooden Boards, 7 Slates, 7 Ribs, 7 Pelvic Bones, and 7 Horse Skulls#k to #bShawn#k the excavator, as evidence.\n- The Excavators -

item.0: We must finish the excavation work soon, before disaster REALLY strikes! Please clear out the camp and bring me proof of your deeds.
